source: Each UOL property was visited once. Canvases were not decoded.

converter_log.name: convert-all.json from the earlier full conversion
converter_log.counting: Codec.serialize counts a UOL again when a resolved link re-enters its target. Those figures are visits, not unique nodes.

resolver.rule: Start at the UOL's parent. Split the link on '/'. '.' stays put, '..' walks to the parent, and any other segment uses a case-sensitive child lookup. Sixteen hops that never produce a non-UOL return cycle, including a hop that landed on a non-UOL at the limit. A repeated node id is also cycle. A null parent or a missing segment is dangling.
resolver.unknown_rule: escaped_image_root and alternate start-node hits stay unknown. The scan does not decide whether the client uses a different relative root.
